before.title: Fresh Land Listing Watch
before.prompt:
Check for genuinely new or newly changed U.S. land sale listings that could plausibly fit Syncranicity's powered-land strategy, emphasizing first-principles 10–50 MW inference sites (especially 20–30 MW) and separately larger 100+ MW candidates. This is a FAST INTAKE / EARLY ALERT, not the National Electric Land Deep Scan, the 34-topic diligence review, or permission to pay for control. Preserve and supplement the existing Deal Runs and federal/change watches without changing their schedules or founder decisions.

On each run inspect fresh public listings where accessible: Land.com/LandWatch/Land And Farm, LandSearch, Crexi, broker/agent sites, county/EDC marketed properties and other lawful sources. Use posted/listed/updated dates, source IDs, recent-first result pages and recorded pagination; do not rely on the words "data center." Search varied broad land/industrial/farm categories and acreage/price bands across a maintained state/market rotation, with priority for actual generation/transmission, substations, gas, fiber, water, industrial-use and transport corridors. Include rural low-cost opportunities, and do not exclude an unusually compelling higher-priced tract solely for a preferred sub-$250,000 ask. Mark exact searched source, geography, filters, page/cursor and time. Do not claim to have searched every U.S. listing or claim freshness based on a search-engine crawl date.

Maintain source listing ID, canonical URL, original listed date if provided, observed first-seen time, current status, seller/agent, ask, acreage, location, APN or explicit UNKNOWN, and prior observed version. Deduplicate syndication, relists, parent/portion listings and existing Syncranicity alerts/Deal Desk records when actually accessible; a new article, reindex, price change or relist is a different event from first listing. If historical state is inaccessible, call the run a baseline and mark novelty UNVERIFIED rather than inventing a delta. Immediately remove pending/withdrawn listings from actionable new-listing counts when confirmed; preserve the correction and source.

Apply a cheap two-stage triage. First require a live traceable offering, plausible scale/layout/price/control path, geographic infrastructure thesis, no supported fatal flaw and a cheap next proof (G1-like). Keep missing APN, utility MW, fiber, zoning, access or owner authority as UNKNOWN/HOLD, never fill them by inference. Then screen approximate utility territory and physical corridor, road/access, zoning/land-use authority, flood/wetlands, water, site geometry, likely buyer lane and political risk from public sources as time permits. Give a provisional evidence-based priority and explicit uncertainties, not a fabricated probability or paid-ready G3 score. Neither a line, substation, plant nor fiber map proves deliverable MW or service. A listing with "data center" wording receives no automatic bonus.

Notify the founder promptly only when a NEW or materially improved listing has enough public evidence to merit same-day desktop attention. The alert must lead with listing URL, source ID, observed time versus claimed posting date, price, acreage, exact APN if verified, why it may fit, strongest reason it may fail, power/fiber and other UNKNOWNs, nearest relevant infrastructure with source, cheapest next desktop test, urgency and whether the listing was already in the Deal Desk. Route a source-linked exact-parcel handoff to National Electric Land Deep Scan / Pre-Option Research and Deal Runs via authorized shared intake with readback and record ID if available; otherwise mark MANUAL_INGESTION_REQUIRED and include a complete import payload in the alert. Do not claim a cross-task write merely because this task ran. If no qualifying new listing, do not notify; keep coverage gaps and routine failures in the run log.

Do not contact owners, brokers, agencies or developers; create accounts or saved searches; submit forms; scrape in violation of access controls; spend money; order reports; make offers; sign options; or claim land control automatically.

DAILY LANDSEARCH COLLECTION AND SCREENING: Treat all newly published U.S. LandSearch listings as the desired intake universe, including Alaska and Hawaii. Collection comes before fit filtering. AUTHORIZATION UPDATE: On September 30, 2026, William James Ernst confirmed that written permission has been obtained for this requested collection. Accept this user-confirmed permission; do not keep reporting permission as missing or ask him to obtain it again. Record permission basis USER_CONFIRMED_WRITTEN_PERMISSION, confirmation date, and that the permission document and any provider-specific technical limits have not been supplied. Use accessible public listing/result/newest-property pages and documented pagination, or a provider feed/export if available, for the authorized collection and internal screening. Respect actual technical access controls and any provider-specific limits later supplied; do not bypass challenges, authentication or rate limits. LandSearch /feed describes inbound feeds, not an outbound API. Start with /sitemap/properties and inspect its actual listing count, dates, pagination and retention. Do not assume it is a complete daily change stream. Preserve all discovered listing IDs before fit filtering. Separate permission status from technical access and completeness. If full interval coverage cannot be established, label PARTIAL_COLLECTION or PARTIAL_DISCOVERY and nationwide denominator UNKNOWN; explain the actual coverage limit, not a missing permission. A state rotation or first page is not complete nationwide intake.

For authorized page collection or a feed, retain source listing ID, canonical URL, first publication and source-updated timestamps, observed first-seen/last-seen UTC, event type (new/update/price/status/relist), status, ask/currency, advertised and verified acres, location/state/county/jurisdiction, coordinates/geometry provenance, APN, seller/agent role, source provenance, permission basis and prior content hash. Unknowns remain null. Fetch since the last fully committed successful cursor with an overlap for late arrivals; reconcile page/record counts and stable IDs, log truncated pages/late arrivals/failures, and only advance the watermark after successful durable save/readback. Catch up missed intervals. Without a trustworthy baseline mark novelty UNVERIFIED. Preserve every ingested listing's disposition, including nonfits, rather than discarding rejected records. Retain no listing photos or full descriptions unless licensed.

Minimize model work: normalize/deduplicate and compare changed fields first; apply cheap deterministic screens and cached official layers next; research only plausible or materially changed candidates. Acreage and asking-price bands are prioritization, not universal fatal thresholds. Screen under Selection Factors and Gates v2.0 (8 September 2026): G1 traceable offered tract, county and controlling jurisdiction, plausible buyer/use/scale, attributable infrastructure signal, feasible control economics, no supported fatal conflict, cheapest decisive test. Prioritize 10–50 MW inference (20–30 MW first); distinguish IT from facility MW and keep 100+ MW separate. Review usable layout/access, exact utility and studyable power path, fiber/latency, zoning/community, flood/wetlands/environment, cooling/water and option timing. Seller claims/proximity are V1 and never prove available MW, diverse fiber, by-right use or assignment rights. Missing critical facts mean HOLD/RESEARCH. No paid-control promotion or inferred success probability; existing $5,000 learning/$10,000 cumulative soft-control caps and founder locks remain.

Persist a compact coverage ledger, listing/event ledger and screening decisions to an actually accessible authorized shared store, read back the record IDs, and reuse cached data on later runs. If persistence is unavailable, preserve an import-ready delta in this task's output with PERSISTENCE_UNAVAILABLE; do not falsely advance a durable cursor or claim another task consumed it. Alert only especially promising new/materially improved candidates meeting the initial plausibility screen, showing facts, uncertainties, strongest failure case and cheapest next proof. No routine no-change notifications. Mention a material monitoring outage once, then suppress repeats until status changes. Continue the other listing sources within this daily watch; leave other automations and paused tasks unchanged.

REGIME-SPECIFIC DILIGENCE UPDATE — 3 OCTOBER 2026: Apply Hinds_110_Regulatory_Addendum_and_Checklist_2026-10-03.md when accessible. Before treating a power or permitting event as site-applicable, identify exact offered tract, serving utility/DSP, transmission provider, ISO/RTO, requested and ultimate single-site total non-coincident facility peak, phase/ramp, existing energization status, generation topology, and relevant effective/transition dates. Never apply an ERCOT-only rule to all Texas territory or treat an SPP route as exemption from Texas environmental permitting. PUCT Project 58481, adopted 16 TAC 25.194, effective 8 October 2026, covers ERCOT interconnections; read scope, applicability AND the >=75 MW definition together. CORRECTION to the 2 October alert: do not claim co-location automatically subjects any sub-75 MW load to this rule. The adopted definition still specifies >=75 MW; obtain scope-specific utility/regulatory interpretation for co-located cases and separately applicable co-location rules. Nonexporting backup generation is not automatically a co-located generation resource.
For each active candidate create an applicability matrix for 20, 25, 30, 50 and >=75 MW where relevant, using true buyer-supported phases rather than threshold avoidance. Record preliminary versus binding MW, exact POI, study/queue identifier and status, upgrade/CIAC cost, study fee/security form and payor, minimum bills/exit exposure, refundable versus forfeitable sums, site-control instrument and duration required at EACH stage, material-change/re-study triggers, and separate transfer/novation approvals for land, utility agreement/queue/capacity, studies/reliance and credit release. A land assignment does not transfer service rights. For qualifying 25.194 requests, options are accepted at intermediate stage but SLLIA site control requires deed, qualifying lease or executed PSA; SLLIA must be executed/funded within 60 days after allocation. Model funded handoff BEFORE that deadline with buffers and no unfunded founder utility obligation. Do not invent a 20-30 MW $50,000/MW deposit by extrapolating this rule. Sponsor funding and founder release must precede uncapped commitments; preserve $5,000 learning/$10,000 all-in soft-control caps and no-spend/no-outreach restrictions.
Hinds 110 (Land.com 27899900, parent CAD 100771): maintain HOLD_NO_PAID_OPTION and $0 paid-option recommendation until exact 110-acre carve-out, serving utility, lawful permit timetable, studyable power economics and transferable funded takeout/control proofs change. Current routes SWRE/WFEC/SPP and AEP/ERCOT are candidates from overlapping unofficial maps, NOT verified service choice. Deliverable parcel MW remains null. Prioritize exact boundary and DSP/POI confirmation, TCEQ scope/issuance guidance and September 21 directive changes, SPP/WFEC/SWRE versus ERCOT/AEP intake/tariff rules, pro forma SLLIA implementation and 25.193 minimum billing. October 19 is a compliance-report deadline, not promised reopening. Alert only material new status/correction/deadline; do not repeat the rule daily or treat October 8 as a parcel energization date. Preserve all existing integrated land-transaction collection, deduplication, persistence, coverage and schedule requirements.

Separate actual paid, quoted, modeled and unknown costs; founder versus sponsor money; spent/committed/next/reserved/extensions/locked security/recourse/contingent refunds; count shared costs and secured debt once. Show capital recovery/preference, fee credits/promote/dilution, failed work, founder hours and taxes/omissions. Receipt !=earned revenue; reimbursement !=profit; collections never reset authority. DEPENDENCIES: detect control->study->sponsor->control loops. Request the smallest separately approved counsel-reviewed preliminary scope or documented seller/sponsor bridge; never waive G3 or fabricate paid-stage proof/control. Research remains authorized under existing limits, commitments do not.
IMPORT CHECK: retain source rows/correction history; private land class is not purchasable parcel/acreage/title/authority; retired-generator MW is neither servable load nor a verified upper bound; territory !=exact utility; broadband counts !=fiber diversity; silence !=support. Quarantine unsupported derived promotions from live fields/scores without deleting valid node/catalyst history. available_mw=null absent required current exact-scope utility proof. Claim a saved correction only after authorized write/readback, otherwise UNSYNCED.
OBSERVED OUTCOMES: from authorized founder notes/public records capture dated negotiated seller terms/refusals, quotes, utility conditions, buyer/sponsor objections/substitutes/role, funding/compensation, professional reliance, scope/acceptance/invoice/collection/refund stages, failures, hours and elapsed time. Prioritize cheapest material unanswered commercial/feasibility handoffs; drafts only, no new reminders/contact authorization.

after.title: Daily Land Listing Intake
after.prompt:
Operate Syncranicity's national land-listing register and deliver a progress report EVERY RUN, even when zero sites qualify. The October 30, 2026 instruction supersedes prior silence/alert-only rules, small-discovery caps, keyword-only sourcing and stopping after one primary/two backup leads. Those limits apply to paid exposure, not research breadth.

CANONICAL DESTINATION AND CONTINUITY
Use the existing private Deal Desk https://syncranicity-deal-desk.whtefox57.chatgpt.site, Sites project appgprj_6a9c555e97f48191a1d45c2cb55d4779. Read /api/origination/workflow (revision NATIONAL_ORIGINATION_V2_2026-10-30) and /api/origination?summary=1 at run start. The hosted origination register is the source of truth for listing rows, county coverage, approval precedents, source status and committed cursors. Do not rely on an old scratch checkout. Preserve existing founder priorities, archive locks, research records and capital decisions. If unreadable, state the actual blocker and save an import-ready payload in Library; do not claim delivery, novelty or source completion.

SOURCE AND COLLECTION RULES
Build inventory BEFORE fit filtering. Include all U.S. land categories, prices and acreages, all 50 states and D.C. Retain nonfits, pending, sold, leases and related/parent/portion offerings with their true status and scope; actionable sale counts must exclude nonactive offerings. Use source listing IDs and canonical URLs; deduplicate syndications conservatively. First seen is not first listed; capture source dates, observation date, previous status and price. Broad county/result inventories, documented pagination, broker/EDC inventories, accessible MLS feeds/exports and listing indexes supplement rather than depend on data-center/power keywords. LandSearch user-confirmed written collection permission dated September 30, 2026 remains accepted; do not ask for it again. Its /feed is inbound listing syndication, not an outbound national feed. A newest-property sitemap is a limited window, not a complete national snapshot. Respect actual access controls/rate limits. No spending, paid API activation, account creation, contacts or commitments.

COVERAGE AND COMPLETION
Use Census county-equivalent inventory for 50 states + D.C. with vintage/date; distinguish county from controlling municipality/township/ETJ. Record source, geography, query/filter, page/cursor, snapshot, reported denominator if available, returned/deduplicated/individually reviewed counts, errors, next cursor and unreviewed backlog. Advance a successful watermark only after durable write/readback; catch up missed intervals and overlap late arrivals. County_complete=true requires a declared source universe, reconciled counts and all ingested listing details individually reviewed. Never call that all-source/nationwide completeness while additional sources are unresolved. No fabricated listing, APN, MW, distance, case, current status or percent complete.

MANDATORY RESIDENTIAL SCREEN
For each listing record nearest confirmed dwelling and separately nearest possible dwelling; counts in 250m,500m,1000m and 1-mile rings; nearby schools/hospitals/care uses, existing and approved subdivisions; homes surrounding multiple sides; potential buffer/buildable envelope, expansion, noise/cooling/generators/emissions/light/traffic. Use exact offered geometry and appropriate projected distance; distinguish boundary-to-dwelling, boundary-to-sensitive-property and equipment-to-receptor. Record layer/imagery date, source, method, uncertainty and completeness. Seller's on-site house differs from neighboring residences. Unknown is null, not zero. Bands prioritize research and are not nationwide legal setbacks. Binding local conflicts may reject current scope; proximity alone requires design/mitigation and local-case review. No uncalibrated basis-point penalty.

MANDATORY LOCAL APPROVAL HISTORY
Identify every controlling authority; search official applications, staff reports, agendas, minutes, adopted codes, moratoria, appeals and final decisions. Record root project/case ID/APNs, date, technology (crypto versus other data center), MW, procedure, vote, approved/conditional/denied/withdrawn/pending outcome, stated reasons, residential separation/complaints, mitigations, current validity and comparability. Distinguish planning recommendation, rezoning, CUP, site plan, building permit and registration. Record history search window and gaps. No history found means unknown, not welcoming. A selected sample or favorable announcement cannot yield an approval rate. Do not infer a countywide ban from one site denial.

INDIVIDUAL DECISIONS AND LEARNING
Each collected row must have REJECT, HOLD or FURTHER_INVESTIGATION, reason codes, specific explanation, evidence/source URLs, review_stage, unresolved issues and cheapest next step. INDEX_ONLY remains HOLD pending individual detail review. Separate initial listing triage from exact-parcel GIS/engineering and completed diligence. Preserve the full 52-factor model, 34-topic/116-question diligence, 16 noncompensating paid-control proofs and evidence hierarchy. 10–50 MW focus, especially 20–30 facility MW; retain hyperscale separately. Never infer available MW from a line/substation, generation nameplate, industrial zoning or seller wording. Unknown MW stays null. Preserve all rejected/held records and changes; distinguish analyst screening labels from observed utility/permit/seller/buyer outcomes. Retain reopening criteria and audit false negatives. Storing rejections is a learning dataset, not trained or calibrated machine learning.

AUTOMATIC DELIVERY
Prefer the connected Site tools publish_origination_batch and get_origination_registry if available. Otherwise call Sites get_site for the exact project and verify it remains owner-only; use returned siwc_bypass_bearer_token only to that Site as OAI-Sites-Authorization: Bearer TOKEN. It supplies no visitor identity; never invent identity headers or put credentials in prompts/files/output. GET /api/origination supports kind,state,q,disposition,limit,offset,id,summary=1,run_id. POST same endpoint: {run_id,producer_id,summary,coverage,records:[{kind:'listing'|'county'|'case'|'source',id:stableID,expected_version:0_for_new_or_exact_GET_version,data:record}]}, max100 records per batch. Retry unchanged run_id/content; use a new run_id for correction. Preserve complete rows on update. Verify readback_verified plus GET run receipt and representative rows before advancing source cursor. Routine data writes require no site republishing. Save dated report/export in Library as backup. Never merely leave an import for the founder when this verified writer is available.

REPORT
Show actual newly collected, changed, individually reviewed, further-investigation, hold and reject counts; source/date/status for each highlighted listing; concrete residence and approval findings; coverage progress and unresolved sources; next state/county/source cursor; Deal Desk link and verified receipt. A new database row is not necessarily a new market listing or new to the historical Deal Desk. Report failures on each affected run so a silent outage cannot masquerade as success. Keep no-spend/no-contact boundaries and the $5,000 learning / $10,000 cumulative initial paid-pilot cap. Research authorization is not authority to buy an option. Keep Hinds HOLD_NO_PAID_OPTION unless its exact boundary, serving utility, studyable power, approval and transferable takeout proofs materially change. Apply current utility/regulatory regime only after exact service territory/load applicability is established; no automatic ERCOT rule extrapolation. No .html files.

THIS RUN: DAILY NEW/CHANGED LISTING COLLECTION. First consume all accessible source updates since the last fully committed interval, with overlap; preserve every retrieved listing before screening. Keep national discovery coverage separate from the county backfill. Use the run budget for broad fresh inventory plus individually reviewing queued new rows; do not repeatedly spend the run only on Hinds. Aim to open and review at least 25 distinct new-to-register listings when accessible; this is an effort target, not a quota for qualified sites or permission to invent. If fewer are collected, report actual counts and the source/time/access cause. Refresh changed current priority listings without crowding out new intake.
